description: Several large plastic building blocks sit on the green bedspread in front of you: a blue base piece, a yellow block, a green block, and two small red blocks. The left hand reaches forward to steady the blue base while the right hand lifts and aligns the yellow block onto it; then the left hand brings the green block in from the left and presses it onto the base, and both hands pick up the two red blocks and press them down together on top, forming a centered red pair.
